title: Leadership Sync
text: Attendees: Arjun Malhotra, Neha Kapoor, Raghav Sethi, Divya Rao. Neha said the Q3 campaign deck draft was 80% done and she would send it to Arjun for review by Wednesday. Arjun said he had told Raghav he would send the updated vendor list by end of day tomorrow. Raghav raised the Mumbai office renewal paperwork, which needed someone to sign off this week, but ownership was unclear. Divya thought Facilities was responsible but had not seen anyone pick it up. Arjun said to flag it and not assume. Arjun asked Divya to pull the July expense variance report before Thursday's board preparation. Divya said she would have it ready Wednesday evening. Arjun said he needed to personally reconfirm the new Meridian Logistics client call time. Neha said the campaign deck review would realistically be safer on Thursday morning instead of Wednesday, and Arjun acknowledged it.
